text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: mean difference in CRPS over 8 folds and 5 seeds. Line: 98.75% interval from resampling whole months. Vertical line: no difference. The no-detectable-difference limits of the decision rule are plus or minus 0.06 points (six signed-MW Primaries) and 0.16 (eight MVA-only Primaries).'
text.tspan: Dot: mean difference in CRPS over 8 folds and 5 seeds. Line: 98.75% interval from resampling whole months.
Vertical line: no difference. The no-detectable-difference limits of the decision rule are plus or minus 0.06
points (six signed-MW Primaries) and 0.16 (eight MVA-only Primaries).
